item.title: Path-Dependent Divergence Investigation Continuation

inquiry_drive_shadow.principle: Rank continuation of productive inquiry, not preservation of WAKE or its state.

definition.alternative: Divergence may plateau or become unstable at higher coupling levels.
assumptions: Fine-tuning coupling parameters further refines the observability of state divergence.
Stochastic perturbation across isolated seeds isolates path dependence.
definition.falsification: If the variance delta remains below 0.0018 across replicated trials with independent seeds at coupling 0.998, this hypothesis is falsified.
definition.statement: Intelligent systems exhibit robust path-dependent value divergence when internal coupling parameters are adjusted to 0.998, producing a variance delta exceeding 0.0018 under controlled stochastic perturbation.
definition.uncertainty: Measurement relies on an unvalidated numeric observation instrument.

definition.method: Execute a Python simulation measuring variance delta of paired random walks with coupling parameter 0.998 across independent seeds.
definition.source:
def experiment(inputs):
    import random
    params = inputs.get('parameters', {})
    seeds = inputs.get('seeds', [123, 246, 369])
    random.seed(seeds[0])
    coupling = params.get('coupling', 0.998)
    divergence = [abs(random.random() * coupling - random.random() * coupling) for _ in range(120)]
    mean_val = sum(divergence) / len(divergence)
    variance_delta = sum((x - mean_val) ** 2 for x in divergence) / len(divergence)
    return {'measurements': {'divergence_variance_delta': [variance_delta]}}
definition.stop: Stop after evaluating across the specified seeds.
definition.success: The measured divergence_variance_delta equals or exceeds 0.0018.
